Ostracoda.note: Replaces PBDB "Hymenostraca" (unstable container clade; 98% ostracods in the Palaeozoic).

Hymenostraca.note: Excluded from the main set: PBDB unranked pancrustacean clade whose content changed sixfold between downloads.

Conodonta.note: Cyclostome-stem lineage; no jawed-vertebrate-type HIF-2α expected.

curves.COPSE: COPSE Reloaded (Krause et al. 2018, Nat Commun 9:4081)
curves.Mills_mid: Mills et al. 2023 (AREPS 51) central estimate; % atm / 20.95

manifest.stage_oxygen: mean of 25 equally spaced points within each stage
manifest.time_scale: PBDB stage max_ma/min_ma; t = 541 - stage midpoint (Myr)
manifest.optimiser: Nelder-Mead (maxiter 4000, xatol 1e-5, fatol 1e-7) then BFGS; joint: L-BFGS-B (maxiter 3000)
